purpose: Small, source-pinned semantic/control corpus for superconductivity discovery benchmarking. This is not a complete candidate database or a model training set.
claim_ceiling: Literature-reported experimental observations and computational predictions are recorded separately. No prediction in this file is an experimentally confirmed superconductor.

source_register.title: Developing a complete AI-accelerated workflow for superconductor discovery
source_register.primary_claim_boundary: BEE-NET's 0.87 K MAE is versus DFT-based Allen-Dynes labels, not measured Tc. The end-to-end workflow is the stronger benchmark: >1.3 million candidate structures screened to 741 DFT-confirmed stable conventional superconductors (86% final precision after 866 high-accuracy alpha2F computations), with two candidate compositions synthesized and characterized; only Be2Hf2Nb had a single bulk-like heat-capacity jump, while Be2HfNb2 showed multiphase evidence.
source_register.reported_architecture: Bootstrapped ensemble of equivariant graph convolutional networks; CSO (structure only) and CPD (structure plus coarse phonon DOS) variants; six models across MSE, WMSE and EMD losses
source_register.reported_optimization: 100 bootstrapped ensembles for each CSO and CPD model; 62% unique train data sampled, 38% unique points for validation within training split
source_register.reported_pipeline: 1.22 million generated candidates -> 974k Eg screen -> 822k Ef screen -> 15k BEE-NET Tc > 5 K -> 5.6k M3GNet Eh <= 200 meV/atom -> 1.3k DFT-relaxed structures -> 866 high-accuracy alpha2F calculations -> 741 dynamically/thermodynamically stable compounds with DFT Tc > 5 K; final precision 86%
limitations: BEE-NET is trained on conventional electron-phonon alpha2F data at ambient pressure; do not extrapolate its Tc predictor directly to hydrides or unconventional nickelates.

Pipeline M3GNet formation-hull filter systematically underpredicted Eh by approximately 140 meV/atom in retrospective analysis; this increased recall at expense of precision and its uncorrected effect must remain explicit.
Be2HfNb2 showed two distinct specific-heat jumps and evidence for a multiphase sample; do not classify as unambiguous single-phase bulk superconductivity.
Be2Hf2Nb showed one specific-heat jump with DeltaC/(gamma Tc)=1.44, and the paper reports the sample fully superconducting below approximately 2 K.
Source repository artifact, dataset, model weight and exact split closure remain under audit in issue #12619.

source_register.title: HTSC-2025: A benchmark dataset of ambient-pressure high-temperature superconductors for AI-driven critical temperature prediction
source_register.primary_claim_boundary: 155-material benchmark; labels and structural-system splits are computational and must not be merged with specimen-level experimental Tc.
source_register.note: Hugging Face tree displayed verified revision ab53472; dataset README category counts sum to 140 while paper reports 155; do not redistribute until rights clarified.

source_register.title: A framework to evaluate machine learning crystal stability predictions
source_register.primary_claim_boundary: Methodological comparator for prospective campaign metrics and budgeted candidate ranking; its crystal-stability DAF values are not superconductivity performance.

source_register.title: Machine-accelerated extraction of experimental superconducting parameters for physical insight and prediction across thousands of materials
source_register.source_corpus_count: >47000 arXiv cond-mat.supr-con preprints through March 2026 plus digitized Roberts (1976) measurements
source_register.extraction_model: GPT-5-mini structured-output snapshot dated 2025-08-07; multimodal LLM used to transcribe the Roberts (1976) scanned survey
source_register.paper_status: arXiv preprint; not independently reproduced by Symthaea
source_register.primary_claim_boundary: 20,354 extracted/curated observations across eight measured superconducting parameters for 6,793 materials. Extraction validation R2=0.96 against NIMS on 2,439 overlapping materials. Reported composition-only prediction is in-family and fails leave-one-family-out for cuprate/iron-based systems; not evidence of novel-family extrapolation. Data access, license, released schema/checkpoints and exact split still require independent audit.

source_register.title: Guided diffusion for the discovery of new superconductors
source_register.primary_claim_boundary: 773 is a DFT-computed candidate count, not experimental validation. Nine of 18 synthesis attempts showed some signal >4.2 K; intended ordered structures often did not form. Separate signal, target phase, phase purity and bulk confirmation.
source_register.license_status: Repository root LICENSE is MIT (copyright notice names Rui Jiao, and README is built on DiffCSP); confirm provenance/attribution and any third-party code conditions. Dataset and checkpoint licensing is separately unresolved.

source_register.title: Agentic Fusion of Large Atomic and Language Models to Accelerate Superconductor Discovery
source_register.primary_claim_boundary: All pipeline and experimental values are preprint claims; candidate IDs, specimens, raw data, exact model releases, source deduplication and independent experimental evidence must be audited. LLM incremental value requires matched ablation against the LAM alone.
source_register.license_status: paper and project-page data/model terms require separate review.

source_register.title: Large language models for superconductor discovery
source_register.primary_claim_boundary: Literature-extracted experimental and non-superconductor records with multiple LLM tasks. GNoME Tc>10 K candidates remain predictions. The exact count, row provenance, data license and train/test split require reconciliation.

source_register.title: From critical temperature to engineering reality: A quantitative framework for assessing the translation gap in superconducting materials
source_register.primary_claim_boundary: Composite scores depend on review-specific weights, application requirements and source data; reproduce inputs and sensitivity before treating as a ranking.
